tools.name: validate_query
tools.description: FREE. Check and normalize a company name or domain before paying for lookup_victim.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: FREE. Prices, network, payment address, data sources and the required 'unverified claim' label.

tools.name: lookup_victim
tools.description: Has a ransomware group claimed this company or domain on a leak site? Returns matching claims (group, dates, country, sector, sources). Every result is an unverified claim from a criminal leak site, not a confirmed breach.

tools.name: recent_claims
tools.description: Newest ransomware leak-site claims (up to 10), optionally for one group. Commercially reusable sources only, so country/sector are often null. Every result is an unverified claim from a criminal leak site, not a confirmed breach.

tools.name: group_profile
tools.description: Profile of a ransomware group: aliases, first observation by RansomLook, and a sample of its newest claims. Every claim is an unverified claim from a criminal leak site, not a confirmed breach.
